audience: hotel teams that run bookings, rates and invoices in Amenitiz

useCases.title: Check the arrivals of the coming week
useCases.text: List the bookings of one property with arrival dates in the coming week. Open one booking and read its payments.

useCases.title: Review the open room stock for the next two weeks
useCases.text: Read how many units are open to sell per unit group and date. List the units of a unit group to see the physical rooms.

useCases.title: Compare room types and rate plans
useCases.text: List the unit groups and the rate plans of one property. Open a unit group to read its details.

useCases.title: Trace the charges and invoices of a booking
useCases.text: List the charges on one booking. Find the invoices of the property by booking reference, then open an invoice to read it.
